title: Japhet in search of a father!
html_source: Japhet, in Search of a Father is an 1836 novel by English writer Frederick Maryatt.

anchor.text: Japhet in search of a father!
anchor.prefix:
to point at Stephen. He himself? 

 Buck Mulligan slung his towel stolewise round his neck and, bending in loose laughter, said to Stephen's ear: 

 — O, shade of Kinch the elder!
anchor.suffix:
— We're always tired in the morning, Stephen said to Haines. And it is rather long to tell. 

 Buck Mulligan, walking forward again, raised his hands. 

 — The sacred pint alon
anchor.canonical_text: Japhet in search of a father!
